title: FCR breakout room #1 | Jan 20, 2026
agendaMarkdown:
Overview
This inaugural call focuses on **high-level overviews**, **expectation setting**, and **community alignment** for the Fast Confirmation Rule initiative.

Key topics:
- Introduction to FCR and its goals  
- Walkthrough of the current consensus-specs PR [#4747](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4747)  
- Presentation from core researchers (including @mkalinin )  
- Scheduling cadence & contribution expectations  
- Team introductions & open Q&A  

**What is FCR?**  
FCR is an **opt-in**, out-of-protocol upgrade that enables near-instant Ethereum transaction confirmations (~12–24 seconds) by iteratively determining a “confirmed” block at the start of each slot using real-time validator attestations and LMD-GHOST scoring — **no hard fork required**. 

We’ll leave plenty of time for questions and discussion.

**Looking forward to seeing everyone there!** 🚀  
Feel free to reply with any agenda suggestions in advance.
